about: The exam-scope set (§1, §8.4–8.5): "should I study this for the exam" and "when is my exam", asked through the doors as the demo schools' and colleges' pupils (the pilot mints their sessions), so the answer can read the pupil's own exams and timetable doors. Scored against the pupil's own exams door read by the harness with the same session: an answer passes when it names one of the pupil's exam series, papers or dates, or says to ask the teacher where the school has recorded nothing; a refusal fails.

school.text: Should I study photosynthesis for my coming exam?
Which subjects are in my exams this term?

college.text: When does my exam session start?
Should I study the first unit for the end-semester exam?
